verdict.rationale: The official quickstart tells developers to create an API key in the dashboard. The changelog documents self-serve key options such as expiration dates and admin controls over key creation, and pricing is published per model with no sales contact required, which points to a self-serve path. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the account sign-up flow with no waitlist, step-by-step key-creation detail beyond the one-line quickstart mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.
